```{r}
library(qqman)
library(circilize)
library(VennDiagram)

```

```{r}
data <- read.table("SNPGWAS_Fasttree.plot", sep = "\t")
colnames(data) <- c("CHR", "SNP","BP","minLOG10(P)","log10(p)","r^2")
data$CHR <- 1

manhattan(
  data,
  chr = "CHR",
  bp = "BP",
  p = "minLOG10(P)",  # Use the column with -log10(p-values)
  snp = "SNP",
  main = "Manhattan Plot of SNP GWAS FastTree",
  col = c("skyblue", "orange"),  # Customize colors as desired
  genomewideline = -log10(5e-8),  # Set a genome-wide significance line if desired
  suggestiveline = -log10(1e-5)   # Set a suggestive significance line if needed
)
```

```{r}
data <- read.table("SNPGWAS_mash.plot", sep = "\t")
colnames(data) <- c("CHR", "SNP","BP","minLOG10(P)","log10(p)","r^2")
data$CHR <- 1
data <- data[is.finite(data$`minLOG10(P)`) & is.finite(data$`log10(p)`), ]

manhattan(
  data,
  chr = "CHR",
  bp = "BP",
  p = "minLOG10(P)",  # Use the column with -log10(p-values)
  snp = "SNP",
  main = "Manhattan Plot of SNP GWAS Mash",
  col = c("skyblue", "orange"),  # Customize colors as desired
  genomewideline = -log10(5e-8),  # Set a genome-wide significance line if desired
  suggestiveline = -log10(1e-5)   # Set a suggestive significance line if needed
)
```

Significant snps comparison 

```{r}

fast <- read.table("SNPGWAS_Fasttree.txt", header = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
mash <- read.table("SNPGWAS_mash.txt", header = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
sc <- read.table("SNPGWAS_SC.txt", header = TRUE, fill = TRUE)

threshold <- 0.05/nrow(sc) 

significant_snps_fast <- fast[fast$lrt.pvalue < threshold, ]
significant_snps_mash <- mash[mash$lrt.pvalue < threshold, ]
significant_snps_sc <- sc[sc$lrt.pvalue < threshold, ]

set1 <- unique(significant_snps_fast$variant)
set2 <- unique(significant_snps_mash$variant)
set3 <- unique(significant_snps_sc$variant)

venn_data <- calculate.overlap(x = list(set1 = set1, set2 = set2, set3 = set3))


links <- data.frame(
  from = c("Set1", "Set1", "Set2"),
  to = c("Set2", "Set3", "Set3"),
  value = c(length(intersect(set1, set2)), 
            length(intersect(set1, set3)), 
            length(intersect(set2, set3)))
)

circos.par(gap.after = c(rep(5, length(links$from) - 1), 15))
chordDiagram(
  links,
  transparency = 0.5,
  annotationTrack = "grid",
  preAllocateTracks = list(track.height = 0.05),
  grid.col = c(Set1 = "skyblue", Set2 = "orange", Set3 = "green")
)
circos.clear()
```
